title_en: Why is a git branch almost free?
title_zh: 为什么 git 分支几乎零成本？
description_en: A branch is a 41-byte pointer. Commits and their parents are the real graph. Made for someone who can commit but has never branched.
description_zh: 分支其实是一个 41 字节的指针；真正的结构在提交和它们的 parent 连成的图里。为会用 git add/commit、但从没用过分支的你制作。证据全部来自一个真实仓库的 .git 目录。
production_notes: Spoken-form rules: say 'dot git' for .git; never read a 40-character SHA aloud; on-screen paths keep exact spelling (preset rule).
The ref-file bytes, the 41-byte size, and the two-parent merge commit shown on screen are real evidence from this repository (SOURCES.md); do not relabel them as illustrations.
Scene budget: 180 s total at 30 fps; narration minimum must stay under ~165 s so the diagrams keep reading time.

lines.en: Here's a puzzle. This project's history holds hundreds of files and half a gigabyte of finished videos. Now, I create a branch.
lines.zh: 先出一个谜题。这个项目的历史里存着上百个文件、半个 GB 的成品视频。现在，我来创建一个分支。

lines.en: One command — and it finishes faster than this sentence. If a branch really copied the project, that speed would be impossible.
lines.zh: 一条命令——还没等这句话说完它就结束了。如果分支真的是复制整个项目，不可能这么快。

lines.en: So pause for a second. What is the smallest thing git could write down, to remember a branch?
lines.zh: 停一秒想一想：git 最少需要记下什么，才能记住一个分支？

scenes.title_zh: 整个分支只有 41 字节

lines.en: The answer sits in one tiny file inside the dot git folder: refs, heads, idea.
lines.zh: 答案就在 .git 文件夹里一个很小的文件中：refs、heads、idea。

lines.en: Forty-one bytes: forty characters naming one commit, plus a newline. That is the entire branch — these exact bytes are from a real repository.
lines.zh: 四十一个字节：四十个字符写着某个提交的名字，外加一个换行符。这就是整个分支——屏幕上的字节来自一个真实仓库。

lines.en: Nothing was copied. Git wrote one line.
lines.zh: 什么都没有被复制。git 只写了一行字。

lines.en: The real structure lives in the commits. Each commit stores a snapshot of your files, plus the name of its parent commit.
lines.zh: 真正的结构在提交里。每个提交保存一份文件快照，再记下它父提交的名字。

lines.en: Follow the parents, and the commits chain into a graph. That graph already holds every version of the project.
lines.zh: 顺着 parent 连起来，提交就串成一张图。项目的每一个版本，这张图里本来就都有。

lines.en: A branch owns none of this. It simply points at one node.
lines.zh: 分支并不拥有这里的任何东西。它只是指向其中一个节点。

scenes.title_zh: 提交只是移动一个指针

lines.en: Watch the pointer do its job. You are on idea, and a second pointer, called HEAD, remembers that.
lines.zh: 看指针怎么干活。你现在在 idea 上，另一个叫 HEAD 的指针记住了这件事。

lines.en: Commit. Git stores the new snapshot, records its parent — and then moves exactly one pointer. Idea now names the new commit.
lines.zh: 提交。git 保存新的快照、记下它的 parent——然后只移动一个指针：idea 现在指向新的提交。

lines.en: Main never moved. The entire difference between your two branches is two small files.
lines.zh: main 一动没动。两个分支之间的全部差别，就是两个小文件。

lines.en: Think about it: if a branch is just a pointer, what does being on a branch actually mean?
lines.zh: 想一想：如果分支只是一个指针，那「在某个分支上」到底是什么意思？

lines.en: Git switch main moves HEAD back, and rebuilds your working folder from main's snapshot.
lines.zh: git switch main 移动的是 HEAD，然后按 main 的快照重建你的工作目录。

lines.en: Nothing about idea is lost. Its forty-one bytes still name its commit, and the graph keeps every snapshot.
lines.zh: idea 没有丢失任何东西：它那四十一个字节仍然指着它的提交，图里也保留着每一份快照。

scenes.title_en: A merge is one commit with two parents
scenes.title_zh: 合并是一个有两个父亲的提交

lines.en: Back on main, git merge idea creates one new commit — with two parents. One line of ancestry comes from main, one from idea.
lines.zh: 回到 main，git merge idea 会创建一个新的提交——它有两个父亲。一条血缘来自 main，一条来自 idea。

lines.en: This is real: the newest merge in this very repository lists exactly two parent lines.
lines.zh: 这是真实的：就在这个仓库里，最新的一次合并提交恰好写着两行 parent。

lines.en: The graph grew by one node, and main moved by one line. That's all a merge is.
lines.zh: 图里多了一个节点，main 往前挪了一行。合并就只是这么一回事。

lines.en: Recap. A branch is a forty-one byte pointer. Commits and their parents are the real graph.
lines.zh: 回顾一下。分支是一个四十一字节的指针；提交和它们的 parent 才是真正的图。

lines.en: Committing moves the current branch's pointer. Merging adds one commit with two parents.
lines.zh: 提交会移动当前分支的指针；合并则是加入一个有两个父亲的提交。

lines.en: That is why branches are free — so make one for everything. Then open dot git, refs, heads, and read your branch with your own eyes.
lines.zh: 所以分支才几乎零成本——放心大胆地为每件事开分支。然后打开 .git/refs/heads，亲眼读一读你的分支。
